summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements (IFRS) for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with MD&A, a press release, and amended articles of association. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, capital return, or management change is announced. The report is incorporated by reference into shelf registration statements, but no offering or deal is disclosed. This is an ordinary financial reporting filing with no special-situation characteristics.
